mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which positively impacts consumer confidence and spending, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns do not show a positive correlation with low UNRATE values over a 20-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests economic expansion, which can lead to higher corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth above 1% does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand in the housing market, which can lead to increased economic activity and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If housing starts do not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over a 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is high and the unemployment rate is low, it may indicate a tight monetary policy, leading to decreased corporate borrowing and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive when FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 6% in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which can lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth above 2% does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high Consumer Price Index indicates inflationary pressures, which can lead to negative S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL above 2.5% does not correlate with negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales suggests strong consumer spending, which can lead to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If retail sales growth above 0.5% does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll employment growth indicates a robust labor market, which can lead to increased economic activity and higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If payroll employment growth above 100k does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days in more than 50% of cases.
